blocks.text: Amorphous solids, crystalline solids ke bar-aks, ba-qaida seh-jehti geometrical shaklein nahi rakhte. Misalein glass, lakri, amorphous (plastic) sulfur, koyla (charcoal), coal aur coke hain.

items: In mein chhote hisse ho sakte hain jahan zarraat ba-tarteeb hon, jinhen crystallites kehte hain, magar door tak qaidgi nahi hoti.
Glass jaise amorphous solids darja hararat ki wasee had mein pighalte hain.
Unhen dhaala aur phoonk kar mukhtalif shaklon mein banaya ja sakta hai.
Un ki heat of fusion ki koi muqarrar qeemat nahi.

blocks.prompt: Glass ko phoonk kar botlein banayi ja sakti hain jabke sodium chloride ke crystal ko is tarah shakal kyun nahi di ja sakti?
blocks.explanation: Glass amorphous hai: us mein long-range order nahi aur sharp melting point nahi, to garam karne par woh darja hararat ki had mein batadreej naram ho kar gaarha liquid banta hai jise sakht hone se pehle dhaala aur phoonka ja sakta hai. Sodium chloride crystalline hai, sharp melting point ke saath; woh achanak patle liquid mein pighalne tak sakht rehta hai, to shakal dene ke liye koi naram marhala nahi.

items: Amorphous solids (glass, lakri, plastic sulfur, charcoal, coal, coke) ki koi ba-qaida shakal nahi, sirf chhote ba-tarteeb crystallites, had mein pighalte hain, dhaale aur phoonke ja sakte hain, aur muqarrar heat of fusion nahi rakhte.
